name: lagerstroemin
summary: Ellagitannin from Banaba (Lagerstroemia speciosa) leaf that activates GLUT4 glucose transporter via insulin signaling pathways. Key active compound alongside corosolic acid in Banaba extracts.
description: Lagerstroemin (ellagitannin class) is associated with glucose transport and metabolic signaling, framing potential relevance to post-prandial glycemic regulation.
safetyNotes: Mostly preclinical or source-extract evidence. Isolated-compound safety is not equivalent to food/herb exposure; use caution with pregnancy, liver/kidney disease, and polypharmacy.
evidence_grade_explanation: The recorded grade (limited evidence) and evidence tier (strong evidence) conflict, so the weaker signal is published pending review.
evidence_rationale: No study design has been recorded for this profile yet.
